definitions.explanation: Chestnuts that have been roasted, typically in their shells. A popular autumn and winter street food in Japan and many other countries.

examples.japanese: {秋|あき}になると{焼|や}き{栗|ぐり}の{屋台|やたい}が{出|で}る。
examples.english: When autumn comes, roasted chestnut stalls appear.

examples.japanese: ほくほくの{焼|や}き{栗|ぐり}を{食|た}べながら{散歩|さんぽ}するのが{好|す}きだ。
examples.english: I like walking while eating hot, fluffy roasted chestnuts.

examples.japanese: {天津|てんしん}{甘栗|あまぐり}という{焼|や}き{栗|ぐり}は{日本|にほん}でもよく{見|み}かける。
examples.english: Roasted chestnuts called Tianjin sweet chestnuts are commonly seen in Japan too.

notes:
A compound of {焼|や}き (roasting) and {栗|くり} (chestnut), with rendaku changing くり to ぐり. Roasted chestnuts are a quintessential autumn treat in Japan, strongly associated with the season alongside {焼|や}き{芋|いも} (roasted sweet potato).

Street vendors selling {天津|てんしん}{甘栗|あまぐり} (Tianjin sweet chestnuts) are a common sight in Japanese cities during the colder months. The chestnuts are typically roasted in a rotating drum with small pebbles, which distributes heat evenly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {焼|や}き{栗|ぐり}の{屋台|やたい}: roasted chestnut stall
- {天津|てんしん}{甘栗|あまぐり}: Tianjin sweet chestnuts (a well-known brand/style)
- ほくほくの{焼|や}き{栗|ぐり}: hot, fluffy roasted chestnuts

RELATED WORDS:
- {栗|くり}: chestnut — the base ingredient
- {甘栗|あまぐり}: sweet roasted chestnuts — specifically the sugar-glazed or naturally sweet variety
- {焼|や}き{芋|いも}: roasted sweet potato — another beloved autumn street food
